title: Participants : accès et transports — Sierre-Zinal (2026 edition)
claims: The organiser's participants page requires every participant to reach the welcome zone at least 45 minutes before their start time, and lists a free shuttle from the bus stop in front of Restaurant Le Bourgeois to the start welcome zone; the tourist shuttle runs every 10 minutes from 03:30 to 05:45 and the runner shuttle every 10 minutes from 09:30 to 10:45.

A special Geneva–Sierre night train departs Geneva at 01:54 and arrives in Sierre at 04:10, calling at Nyon 02:21, Morges 02:41, Renens 02:48, Lausanne 02:54, Vevey 03:08, Montreux 03:14, Aigle 03:28, St-Maurice 03:37, Martigny 03:48 and Sion 04:01; discounted CFF tickets of up to 50% are available in limited quantities.

Regular rail service to Sierre includes one IR90 and one IR95 train per hour per direction on the Brig–Genève-Aéroport corridor, one to two regional trains per hour per direction, and up to four Geneva–Sierre trains per hour during the day.
The return from Zinal to Sierre starts at 12:00, the supporters' bus reaches Zinal no later than 08:50, and regular train and bus lines serve the Val d'Anniviers.

On the 2026 race day the Anniviers road from Sierre was interrupted in both directions from 04:40 to 05:25, 05:40 to 06:25, 10:25 to 10:35 and 10:55 to 11:30; the descent from Vissoie to Sierre was closed from 10:25 to 12:30 with a detour via Vercorin, Zinal to Vissoie was closed from 11:45 to 13:30 with a detour via Grimentz, and Ayer to Chandolin was closed from 06:00 to 14:00 with access via Vissoie.

Parking is available in Sierre and the Val d'Anniviers but places are limited, so the organiser recommends public transport; vans and campervans use Parking Cremo – Îles Falcon in Sierre for CHF 5, open from Friday 17:00 to Sunday evening, with no reservation and first-come, first-served access.
These timetables, road closures and parking arrangements are published for the 2026 edition; the 2027 edition (Saturday 7 August) had not published its own arrangements on the check date.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 用桌面 UA 直接请求官网参与者交通专页及其子页（accès départ Sierre、parking、adaptation circulation、train spécial、train & bus、parking vans），HTTP 200，正文可读；抄录接驳、夜车时刻、常规铁路、返程、2026 届封路与房车停车规则。所有班次与封路均为 2026 届，2027 届未发布。
